lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid pattern posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a progressive increase in diameter and inter-spot distance along the anterior-posterior axis, with three primary horizontal rows of larger blobs visible on the upper flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a tessellated grid. The high-luminance blobs are primarily localized within the rectangular cells formed by these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and significant shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A slender, high-luminance teleost fish is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
